description: This file defines interfaces for a utility module handling command-line options related to diff formats of merge commits in a version control system, including configuration, suppression, and default setting functions.

methods.name: diff_merges_config
methods.description: Configures diff merges settings based on a string value.

methods.name: diff_merges_parse_opts
methods.description: Parses command-line options related to diff merges.

methods.name: diff_merges_suppress_m_parsing
methods.description: Suppresses parsing of diff merge options.

methods.name: diff_merges_suppress
methods.description: Suppresses diff merges for the given revision info.

methods.name: diff_merges_default_to_first_parent
methods.description: Sets the default diff format to first parent.

methods.name: diff_merges_default_to_dense_combined
methods.description: Switches default diff format to dense combined.

methods.name: diff_merges_set_dense_combined_if_unset
methods.description: Sets dense combined diff format if it is not already set.

methods.name: diff_merges_setup_revs
methods.description: Initializes revisions info for diff merging purposes.
